scope: Concrete separate-sync analog output circuit for the four-ASIC physical design. Native electrical ECO and nominal/corner screens, not fabricated hardware or universal SCART/TV compatibility.
decision: Use a real low-impedance SDTV line amplifier followed by 75ohm series termination. Shape the sync edge BEFORE the amplifier. Do not put a large shunt capacitor on the outgoing coax node and call its DC resistance a broadband75ohm source.

buffer.interpretation: Low-current DC level limits, not an ideal zero-ohm rail-to-rail analog source. Divider branch transient bound excludes capacitance on the short preceding U42 PCB trace. Digital transition ringing and actual load remain layout/prototype observations.

amplifier.supply: V3V3, same rail as U42: no V5-to-V3V3 partial-power input domain
amplifier.filter_model: Fifth-order Butterworth, nominal 8.5MHz. Numerical idealized response is not a vendor macromodel or guaranteed pole set.
amplifier.unused_channels: Inputs2/3 tied toGND, outputs6/7 explicitly native no-connect. Do not divide the IC quiescent current by3.
amplifier.power_scope: The 0.16 W U43 value is an internal diagnostic allocation, not a console rating or measured device dissipation. Include it within the selected internal heat load; load waveform and actual PCB thermal paths require qualification.

operating_acceptance.status: Explicit physical design/procurement/measurement envelope, not a newly proven rail or startup/PVT guarantee.
operating_acceptance.amplitude_scope: Own prototype acceptance into the precision75ohm test load; NOT asserted as a verified universal SCART tolerance or a whole-life corner guarantee.
operating_acceptance.timing_scope: One DAC-sample path-alignment acceptance at the physical output. Common digital tags, falling-edge RGB launch, DAC capture/pipeline and analog sync RC/filter must be accounted together; no unexplained extra sync register.
operating_acceptance.same_rail_input: During arbitrary supply ramps no valid-TV claim; U42 and U43 use the same physical rail. The scaled input remains below that rail. Reset/live-beam semantics are unchanged.

layout_acceptance.capacitance_scope: Total includes actual C533, IC input and PCB/probe/stub contribution; 2pF IC is typical only. This bounded layout/fixture capacitance must be established.
layout_acceptance.output_note: TI requires isolation by75ohm series resistor. Keep pre-R528 amplifier trace/pad capacitance within25pF; do not add a shunt-C on SCART_CSYNC.
layout_acceptance.divider_layout: Keep scaled-node loop short over continuousGND, away from switch nodes. Place100nF and local22uF next to U43 supply/return; native layer/routing reservations are not filled copper.
layout_acceptance.cable_model: A correctly terminated75ohm coax is a transmission line with propagation delay, not its full lumped capacitance added again at the source.
prototype_checks: Both terminal edges and threshold alignment
Chosen internal harness and external cable

rail_design_screen.limits: PublishedVFB row uses VOUT5V/continuous-mode test conditions. NativeU20.MODE=GND isEco-mode at light load. No found guaranteed separate FB-bias/line/load-regulation bound. Screen plausibility only; real rail must meet operational acceptance.

rejected_candidates.reason: DCsource74.5ohm but outputcap makes frequency-dependent~50-j35ohm at1MHz. Buffer analog low-current guarantee also not applicable at7mA. Do not rebrand DC match as broadband match.

sources.use: Concrete native console analog-output project; distinct TTL/75ohm sync choices and retained reference termination topology, not a validation of this design.
Implementedvideo-amplifiergain2and75ohmoutput pattern; exact BMSX values from its own circuit/manufacturer references, not copied.
